yt.title: How many retirees really have $1 million? It depends #Shorts
yt.description:
Households 65+ (Federal Reserve, 2025 SCF): everything ~32%, without the house ~23%, savings ~18%, 401(k)/IRA ~11%.

Full video: https://youtu.be/0KMtZW6mnmA

Sources: Federal Reserve Board, 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances, summary extract public data (our calculation with survey weights; all figures in 2025 dollars); Bengen (1994), 4% rule of thumb.
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.
Narration is AI-generated.
